generation.explanation: This is Bayes' theorem in action. The disease is rare (1 in 100), so even though the test correctly flags 90% of sick people, it also falsely flags 10% of the much larger healthy population. Those false positives outnumber the true ones, leaving only about an 8.3% chance that a positive result means you actually have the disease.
